svg.title: Three-channel EMG RMS envelopes by cued class
svg.desc: Three panels show median and interquartile range across all Session 4 repetitions for four gestures and relaxed-finger tilt controls. Each value is RMS within a 50 millisecond bin of the processed EMG channel.
svg.text: Channel activity profiles across all prompted cues
Session 4 processed EMG; 30 cue-relative RMS bins; median line and middle-50% band
20 repetitions per gesture; 40 relaxed-finger tilt-control cues
Cue-relative time (ms; each cue normalized to 1.5 s)
